Overall Endgame Builds Tier List for Diablo IV Season 15 - Hell's Legacy

by Maxroll
Season 15 - Hell's LegacyLast Updated: September 26, 2026

Advertisement

This website is supported by ads.

This Tier List defines the performance of all builds across a variety of factors including speed, power, defenses but also soft factors like gearing requirements and ease of play. Effectively, this list represents our "authors' recommendations" of the best performing builds across all content to enjoy the season with.

The arrows indicate where an item has moved since our last Tier List update.
Builds are ranked line by line within tiers.
